name: SIQ - Image Mosaic Wall
description: Premium masonry-style image gallery with Pinterest-inspired layout. Add unlimited images as blocks with captions, links, and category tags. Features category filter tabs with animated transitions, 3 layout modes (masonry, even grid, horizontal scroll), fullscreen lightbox with arrow navigation, hover overlays with icon + title + subtitle, scroll-reveal stagger animations, adjustable columns, gaps, border radius, and aspect ratios. Dark and light themes. 80+ customization options. Perfect for portfolios, lookbooks, brand galleries, and project showcases.
author: SectionIQ
